brief: An investment fund that acquires industrial and logistics assets with large existing grid connections. The identity should feel disciplined, durable and confident, with one clear idea about power that investors remember.
criteria: Success: one idea, readable as a name at any size, works in one colour and reversed, ownable beyond the generic power icon.

concepts.name: MORE POWER
concepts.idea: Each O in the name is a power switch: MORE is navy with a blue switch, POWER is blue with a navy switch, and in the mark the two meet in one shared core.
rationale: One idea, carried by a single detail in the name
The mark is literally the two Os of the name
Built on Inter Display with custom Os, outlined, no live type

recommendation: Use the one-line wordmark as the primary logo, the shared-O lockup for square formats, and the mark for icons.
next_steps: Roll out to deck, website and signage
